key.name: poll-interval-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, status and resources are refreshed while a Twingate menu is open. The connection status is checked six times less often in the background.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Send a native notification when the connection state actually changes (connected/disconnected/error). Note: GNOME's own Do Not Disturb setting already suppresses notification banners system-wide regardless of this setting.

key.name: resource-authentication-popups
key.description: Show banners for the official twingate-notifier's Additional authentication required requests. When disabled, requests and their Authenticate action remain in the notification list. Account sign-in prompts and other notifications are unaffected. Applies while Twingate Quick Access is enabled.

key.name: ping-enabled
key.description: Show an on-demand ICMP check for concrete resource hosts. There are no background pings. A missing response does not mean an application is unavailable.

key.name: ping-interval-seconds
key.description: Legacy preference retained for rollback compatibility. Automatic pings are no longer used.

key.name: show-panel-icon
key.description: Quick Settings is always available. Also show a dedicated Twingate panel shortcut.

key.name: favorite-resources
key.description: Stable resource identifiers selected by the user. Only resources returned by the active client account are shown.

key.name: resource-links
key.description: A JSON object mapping exact resource addresses or aliases to user-configured HTTP or HTTPS destinations. Links only open following an explicit click.
